changeSet.author: nidan

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinlims.organization_organization_type oot JOIN clinlims.organization o ON o.id = oot.org_id JOIN clinlims.organization_type ot ON ot.id = oot.org_type_id WHERE o.name = 'Default Location' AND ot.short_name = 'referring clinic'

changeSet.comment: Link Default Location to the referring clinic org type
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.organization_organization_type (org_id, org_type_id) SELECT o.id, ot.id FROM clinlims.organization o JOIN clinlims.organization_type ot ON ot.short_name = 'referring clinic' WHERE o.name = 'Default Location' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.organization_organization_type x WHERE x.org_id = o.id AND x.org_type_id = ot.id );
